typography.headings: Inherit from existing setup, ensure tight tracking (`tracking-tight`) for large sizes.
typography.body: Inherit from existing setup, maintain high legibility (`leading-relaxed`).
typography.labels: Use 3D DOM overlays (`<Html>` from `@react-three/drei`) for all text inside 3D canvases to keep it crisp, accessible, and easily selectable. Use uppercase + wide tracking (`tracking-[0.2em]`) for overlines.

visual_enhancers.isometric_3d: Orthographic projection to perfectly match existing SVG angles. No perspective distortion.
visual_enhancers.materials: Flat shading only. Use `meshBasicMaterial` to prevent realistic lighting, shadows, or glossy gradients. The aesthetic must remain strictly vector-like.
visual_enhancers.hairlines: Use Drei's `<Edges>` or `EdgesGeometry` with color `#0B0B0D` and thin line width to replicate the exact SVG stroke look.
visual_enhancers.glow: For glowing packets on wires, use pure colors with bloom post-processing, or fake it using bright flat colors with a soft HTML radial shadow behind them.

features_section.composition: 3 separate isometric islands (SOURCES, FLUXVEX AI, DELIVERY).

motion.idle: Islands slowly float (sine wave on Y axis).
motion.hover: Target island lifts slightly, drop shadow softens.
motion.drag: Slight tilt/rotation of the island (clamped to +/- 15 degrees) using cursor mapping.

features_section.labels: <Html> billboards floating above elements with 'data-testid' attributes.

why_a_prompt_isnt_a_reporting_system.composition: Split view. Left: Messy, chaotic dashed wires looping (Claude representation). Right: Clean, straight, organized pipeline (Fluxvex).

motion.idle: Chaotic particles moving wildly on left, smooth synchronized glowing packets moving on right.
motion.hover: Messy wires repel cursor (spring physics). Pipeline wires glow brighter on hover.

how_it_works.composition: Sequential pipeline: Source tiles (Google Ads, Meta) -> Hub -> Report Doc.
how_it_works.camera: OrthographicCamera. Pan camera or sequence reveal based on scroll.

motion.hover: Hovering a node pauses the local packet flow, node expands, reveals detailed `<Html>` tooltip.

inside_fluxvex.composition: Dashboard representation separated into isometric Z-layers.

motion.hover: Hovering expands the gap between Z-layers (parallax effect), demonstrating depth and architecture.

platform.composition: Central Fluxvex AI Hub with orbiting source tiles connected by dashed wires.

motion.idle: Slow continuous orbital rotation of the source tiles around the hub.
motion.drag: User can grab and spin the entire orbit.
motion.click: Clicking a source tile centers it and reveals its data points.

our_vision.composition: Grand overarching scene. Hub, Docs, floating 'Authorized', 'Client-ready' billboards.
our_vision.camera: OrthographicCamera, zoomed out to show the full ecosystem.

motion.hover: Cursor movement tilts the entire scene slightly (parallax on mouse move).

performance_rules.context: Use `@react-three/drei`'s `<View>` component to share a single WebGL context across the entire page while rendering in multiple DOM nodes. If `<View>` is too complex for setup, use separate canvases but heavily optimize.
performance_rules.visibility: Pause rendering when offscreen. Use `frameloop='demand'` if scenes are mostly static, but since they have traveling packets, use `frameloop='always'` but early return in `useFrame` if an IntersectionObserver marks the canvas as off-screen.
performance_rules.geometry: InstancedMesh for repeated elements like data packets to reduce draw calls.

accessibility_and_fallback.reduced_motion: Detect `@media (prefers-reduced-motion)`. If true, disable idle floating and travelling packets.
accessibility_and_fallback.webgl_fallback: Keep the existing SVG `<IsoKit>` components as fallback if WebGL fails to initialize or is disabled.
accessibility_and_fallback.dom_labels: Because text is rendered in the DOM via `<Html>`, screen readers can access it. Ensure `aria-hidden='true'` on the Canvas itself, and handle focus manually on the DOM overlays.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You are writing for a React 19 CRA environment (use .js / .jsx, not .tsx unless configured).
DO NOT use generic 3D looks (no PBR, no gloss, no shadows baked into textures). The aesthetic is strict flat vector isometric.
Ensure all DOM overlay elements (buttons, billboards, labels) have `data-testid` attributes. Example: `data-testid='how-it-works-hub-label'`.
When positioning `<Html>` components from Drei, use `center` and `transform` props for crisp UI.
Use Tailwind for styling all `<Html>` DOM nodes, preserving the exact #3D43E8 and #F4F2ED brand colors.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds behind text in the `<Html>` popups; always give them a solid background (e.g., `#FFFFFF`) with a 1px border (`#0B0B0D`) to stand out.
To achieve isometric dashed wires, use Drei's `<Line>` component with `dashed={true}`, or build a custom line material.
Implement mouse-driven tilt using `framer-motion-3d` or raw `useFrame` math with `THREE.MathUtils.lerp` for smooth dampening. Target 60fps.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Create a new `Iso3DKit.jsx` (or `.js`) equivalent to the old `IsoKit.jsx`. It should contain reusable `IsoPlane`, `IsoWire`, `IsoHub`, `IsoBillboard` implemented as R3F components.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Setup a master `<Canvas>` or implement IntersectionObserver logic to only run `useFrame` animations when the user is actively viewing a section.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Migrate `FeaturesGrid`, `HowItWorks`, `Platform`, `Vision`, and `WhyAiComparison` one by one, replacing the SVG components with the 3D `<Canvas>` wrapped components.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Verify `data-testid` is present on all `<Html>` overlays and interactive elements.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Test on mobile viewport (scale down zoom, disable expensive hover listeners).
